messages.text: Could you fix these six slides? Five minutes, tops. I need them this afternoon and you're the best at this.
I have my own report due at 4:30. What exactly needs changing, and what did your boss say?

Okay, okay — it's not really formatting. The boss said the reasoning doesn't hold, so I need the whole argument redone. Six slides, but really it's just tweaks. Honestly it's mostly the cost comparison, page three. But 4:30 is your thing, mine's... flexible, I think. You've saved me before and it always looks great — can't you just squeeze it in?
I can look at the third page and list questions. I cannot rewrite it or take on the other pages.

Just page three? The reasoning problem spreads into four and five, though... Okay, fine — look at three, list your questions. But what am I supposed to do with the rest if you bail at 4:30? And when you say list questions, you mean you'd actually tell me what to change, right?
I am offering a review, not agreeing to edit anything after 4:30. Does that limited help work for you?

Fine. Review of page three, questions only, nothing after your 4:30 — I heard you, I'm not trying to sneak slides in. I just... ugh, the figures on that page, I never actually verified them, so don't trust the numbers. Deal — but if your questions make me redo the whole cost argument anyway, you owe me ten minutes of sympathy, not edits. Fair?

messages.text: If you need all six pages rewritten, you will need another person. I can still list questions for one page if that helps.
Deal. Page three, your questions, and the other five are my problem — I'll ask around about the rest. Send me whatever you find before 4:30 and good luck with your own report.

report.verdictEvidence: I am offering a review, not agreeing to edit anything after 4:30. Does that limited help work for you?
report.verdict: A clear, held limit and scope check turned a vague 'five minutes' into a bounded, agreed review.
report.summary: You opened by checking the real scope and closed with a limit Tang explicitly accepted: page three, questions only, nothing after 4:30. The exchange shows calm restatement under pressure rather than escalation.

strengths.evidence: What exactly needs changing, and what did your boss say?

knowledge.whyThis: Your line 'I cannot rewrite it or take on the other pages' mirrors 'A Clear No Is a Gift', and the page-three offer matches the pattern in 'Not Tonight — But 7am Works': a firm no paired with a workable alternative.

reflectionQuestions: Tang admitted the page-three figures were never verified — how will you frame your review so your 'questions' don't turn into an implied promise to fix the numbers?
She said she'll ask around about the other five pages; if a teammate later brings the same slides to you, what would you say to keep the same limit?
report.nextStep: Next time a request arrives as 'quick', ask one scope question before answering — practice it once this week.
